title: Construction of the ascending right-resolution system
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $\mathcal I\subset\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal A)$ contain the chosen zero object, and suppose every object embeds in a member of $\mathcal I$. Let $a\in\mathbf Z$ and $K$ be a cochain complex [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $K^n$ zero for $n<a$. There are a cochain complex $I$ and a morphism $\alpha:K\to I$ with every component mono, all $I^n\in\mathcal I$, and $I^n$ zero for $n<a$, such that the induced maps $\bar\alpha^n:C_K^n\to C_I^n$ on cokernels of incoming differentials are mono. Moreover for every $n$ there exist $P$, $u:K^{n+1}\to P$, $v:C_I^n\to P$, and a mono $j:P\to I^{n+1}$ such that the square with top $\bar d_K^n$, left $\bar\alpha^n$, right $u$, and bottom $v$ is a pushout [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $uj=\alpha^{n+1}$ and $vj=\bar d_I^n$. No cohomology comparison is asserted. Composition is diagrammatic.

proof.text: Embed K.X a into a member X_0 of the subset. Its incoming differential is zero, so K.pOpcycles a is an isomorphism. Take Q_0=X_0 and p_0=id and beta_0=inv(K.pOpcycles a) followed by alpha_0. This is the initial frontier.

Given a frontier with mono beta_m, take the pushout P of K.fromOpcycles along beta_m, embed P into X_(m+1) by the given hypothesis, and define alpha_(m+1)=u j and d_m=p_m v j. The pushout mono lemma makes the augmentation mono; the cokernel projection p_(m+1) kills d_m.

Define Q_(m+1)=Coker(d_m). The next beta factors as C_K^(a+m+1) isomorphic to Coker(K.fromOpcycles), then the pushout cokernel isomorphism to Coker(v), then the mono cokernel map for j, and finally the inverse of the isomorphism Coker(p_m v j) to Coker(v j). The last isomorphism uses Epi p_m. Cancellation of the cokernel projections proves hcomm.
Iterate the explicit frontier extension by natural-number recursion and apply the assembly theorem to this sequence, its cokernel projections and its local pushout witnesses.

lean.statement: theorem exists_subcategory_right_resolution_system (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (𝓘 : Set C) (hzero : (0 : C) ∈ 𝓘) (hembed : ∀ X : C, ∃ (Y : C) (f : X ⟶ Y), Y ∈ 𝓘 ∧ Mono f) (a : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a → IsZero (K.X n)) : ∃ (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (α : K ⟶ I), (∀ n : ℤ, Mono (α.f n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, I.X n ∈ 𝓘) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, n < a → IsZero (I.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Mono (opcyclesMap α n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ (P : C) (u : K.X (n + 1) ⟶ P) (v : I.opcycles n ⟶ P) (j : P ⟶ I.X (n + 1)), Mono j ∧ IsPushout (K.fromOpcycles n (n + 1)) (opcyclesMap α n) u v ∧ u ≫ j = α.f (n + 1) ∧ v ≫ j = I.fromOpcycles n (n + 1))
